assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
A clinical indication note exists and is being referenced as documentation.
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations.
The patient reports a sensation of irregular heartbeat.
These symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities.
The purpose is to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities.
The denial is eligible for reconsideration/appeal.
Medical necessity is documented, supporting the appeal.
